notes.title: Patch Notes 2.0.58940 (Spoilers)
notes.notes:
New Features & Gameplay Adjustments



Reworked all the camping spots in Throes of the Watchmaker to increase variety.

Updated the train and mini rail buggy so they can now be controlled by all players during co-op play.

Adjusted the timing on multiple combat skills.

Tweaked the block timing for Narcis King's “Ganonball” attack to improve counterplay.

Made overall combat balancing adjustments in the DLC.

Optimized game performance.

Added the ability to generate a DLC-ready save from a New Game + save.

DLC bosses now count for the “What a Technique!” achievement.

Made select DLC trinkets available in the base game.

Revised several cutscene dialogues in the base game for improved narrative flow.

Added highlights on enemy locks when a target is selected, now active in both the DLC and the base game.



Bug Fixes



Fixed an issue where the Dweller of Scourge would switch heads when entering a cutscene.

Resolved a bug where Arty wouldn’t play rest animations when camping on the world map.

Fixed a visual issue where one of the mirrors in the Ivory Tower’s throne room appeared lowered on entry.

Corrected a bug causing Zale to face the wrong direction when using Entarte during an encounter in Wolf Rock.

Fixed an issue allowing player movement during a cutscene after solving a puzzle in Rail Forest.

Resolved a stacking audio bug in Big Top where the ticking timer sound would overlap when using the graplou repeatedly on the pullout block.

Added a missing sound effect when completing the fan & balloons puzzle in Horloge.

Fixed an issue that would cause a softlock when GBB tried to cast Pogpwn.

Corrected premature dialog triggers related to Keenathan not feeling well.

Fixed an issue where the yellow star marker remained on the map for Ivory Tower and Wolf Rock after completion.

Resolved a black screen issue that could occur when triggering a fight while exiting the combat challenge box in Horloge.

Fixed a bug where a ladder would fail to unroll during a puzzle sequence in Big Top.

Resolved a softlock caused by players getting stuck in the Jugglecore animation.

Fixed a softlock in Big Top triggered by using the drone simultaneously with the start of combat.

Addressed an issue where music sheets wouldn’t sell out in Horloge’s shop.

Fixed a progression-blocking bug where the clown face in Big Top would be lowered without ladders after reloading.

Corrected a bug in Wolf Rock where a block could be pushed out of bounds, blocking progress.

Fixed an issue where Sky Giants Island remained hidden on the map after being visited.

Resolved a potential crash when initiating combat while standing on a floor switch.

Fixed possible red sprite artifacts on the Artificer.

Addressed various other minor bugs and glitches across both the DLC and the base game.

notes.title: The Dawn of Equinox Update is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The Dawn of Equinox update is available to download for free on all platforms, right now!

Here’s the new trailer, showcasing some of the main changes coming with the update:

[previewyoutube=pk6FYIift0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We ultimately see Dawn of Equinox as the community’s gift to us - the overwhelming support you’ve all shown us ever since we first announced Sea of Stars helped give our team the chance to return to the project, and present a refined version of it including everything we ever hoped this adventure to be.

There's even more in store in the upcoming DLC Throes of the Watchmaker, but in the meantime, we couldn’t be happier with how Sea of Stars feels with this major update.

DAWN OF EQUINOX UPDATE OVERVIEW

In case you missed it, the key changes were presented comprehensively during a livestream a few weeks ago.

3 Player Couch Co-op

Sea of Stars’ adventure is now playable in its entirety by up to three players, with allies traversing the world together and mastering a new Co-op Timed Hits combat mechanic. Yes, what was initially presented as a more limited “Single Player +” mode has evolved into a full-fledged co-op experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/4a320147836eac1c83a1c22f85b5ef7ac1cd8485.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/f0f63a72d8c74a6d5fcc6272e1366477523d2a43.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/7a836d6af59acc2d08d7c5edab06a93063a4e8d7.png

Combat 2.0

The addition of Mystery Locks brings a new gameplay loop around revealing the ways to break the spells of new enemies entering the fray. Along with "Reveal" functions added to some of the special skills, Combo Points now remain after battle, offering new ways to open certain encounters, or test different damage types on enemies to reveal their locks. 

A comprehensive balancing pass has also been done to reflect both these new changes and player feedback since launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/6234c5decad3c300d7105e087b2267bc8fc504b6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/127a0baaa284716c11bbe25c34605cb884bec91a.png

A revamped prologue

Implementing combat for the young versions of our heroes, the updated flow does away with the flashback structure to begin in their childhood directly including action in the prologue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/c8caf743e97cb06e7b3efded71d75581bbac1b2d.png

Bonus Cinematic Scene

An entirely new cutscene has been added to accentuate a pivotal moment in the original adventure, referred to as "Paths on Water".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/c91cbd8a2e266dfcc0fddce488188f073196d18e.png

Speedrunner Mode Relic

This new Relic was designed with the help of the speedrunning community, activating a range of features helpful for those looking to set a new personal best or world record.

Difficulty Presets

Three difficulty settings are now available when starting a new game, which are presets using the game's Relics. New Relics have also been added, some for quality of life, and others for difficulty adjustments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/a3336be64774dcce23dd2601de363027ac172b06.png

Improved Parrot Relic

The secret-tracking parrot has learned a few new tricks to better assist players tracking down overlooked challenges and collectibles.

Québécois Localization

The long-awaited, comprehensive French Canadian translation for our Québec folks is now available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/6b2f88a138eccb32dc7a3164d5c934ffeb139a70.png

A number of other general updates, bug fixes and QoL improvements spanning Sea of Stars’ full campaign are also part of the Dawn of Equinox update.

THAT’S IT FOR NOW

We’re grateful for all the love and support the game has received over the past year, which made it possible for us to fully realize our vision. We hope this will give fans of the game plenty of reasons to revisit it while waiting for the upcoming DLC Throes of the Watchmaker, coming Spring 2025.

All the love,

-SaboTeam

notes.title: 2023 RPG standout Sea of Stars details free update coming real soon
notes.notes:
You really need to play Sea of Stars. What Yacht Club Games did to revitalize 8-bit platformers with Shovel Knight, Sabotage Studio did for retro-style RPGs with its 2023 hit. Taking cues from genre greats like Earthbound, old-school Final Fantasy, and Chrono Trigger, it's a sublime turn-based adventure. It's so good in fact, that it's turned more people than I can name around on the genre of turn-based RPGs. So if you're yet to play it or want to drag an unassuming friend along for the ride, the newly revealed Sea of Stars Dawn of Equinox update will be the perfect time.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: 2023 Release + PlayStation Announcement
notes.notes:
As we are nearing an important production milestone, the road to launch materializes and we have important updates for you! Let's jump right in.

SEA OF STARS IS COMING TO PS4 AND PS5

It was always the plan to bring Sea of Stars to as many people as possible, but as with all things, planning and timing were key. Through PlayStation's Indie Spotlight event, we are happy to confirm today that Sea of Stars will be available on both PS4 and PS5 on launch day, cross-buy.

For over a year we have been working with PlayStation dev kits to make sure it ran as smoothly as on our other target platforms. To avoid spoilers, we showcased the same content as the Nintendo Switch trailer, but still made a point to recapture everything on PS4 and PS5 directly!

(If you want to help bring more eyeballs to Sea of Stars, please RT this post!)

[previewyoutube=yn7YkHsPiDE;full][/previewyoutube]

SEA OF STARS WILL RELEASE IN 2023

Emphasizing our two main priorities (quality of the finished game, and a healthy work-life balance for the team), production remains a road where the unexpected occurs a lot even if the destination is set. Where there is a wall we tear it down, where there is a tree we walk around it, and where there is a gem we pick it up. The vision remains clear, but seeing the response and hype we made the conscious decision to make sure to leave no gems on the floor. Something special is happening here, and we are committed to making the most of it.

We also want to make sure Sea of Stars is the best experience possible for everyone, which implies considerable efforts in terms of performance optimization, accessibility, localization, QA and porting.  

A precise release date will be announced as soon as we pass the Beta milestone.

Once again, thank you all for your overwhelming positivity and patience. 

NEXT STEPS

With virtually all technical risks  already tackled, the team is focused on finalizing the game's content. 

In closing, we want to once again thank you for your patience. It’s a long ride, and your overwhelming support goes a long way in keeping the team's motivation high. We feel truly blessed, and can’t wait for you to experience Sea of Stars in its final form.

With love,

-SaboTeam

notes.title: Production Update + Spring Q&A Stream
notes.notes:
Q&A + WIZARD LAB DUNGEON PREVIEW ON TWITCH THIS FRIDAY MAY 13TH, AT 2PM EST / 11AM PST / 8PM CET

[previewyoutube=XilwGr_HAiM;full][/previewyoutube]

Back in February, around 20 minutes of new content from Sea of Stars was shown to a selected few media outlets. This preview included an updated look on many systems and a quest involving pirates, the port town of Brisk and mysterious arcane ruins known as the “Abandoned Wizard’s Lab”. 

Polish has gone a long way since our last stream, so we wanted to share this segment of Sea of Stars with our community. Make sure to tune in on Twitch this Friday May 13th, at 2PM EST / 11AM PST / 8PM CET! 

https://www.twitch.tv/sabotagestudio

The second half of the stream is reserved for Q&A. Join us if you are curious about the behind the scenes, or have a question of your own! We opened a #qna channel on Discord to drop your questions ahead of time.

Rest assured that this preview won’t reveal critical story beats or spoil anything other than lower-stakes events from the game. 

QUICK DEV UPDATE

In other news, here are a few spoiler-free dev updates you might have missed on social media. Most of these are low risk items we were saving for later in production. It's pretty exciting to be at a point where we are tackling these kinds of things! 

First, we’ve been asked many times over the last 2 years whether the full battle party would be seen running around outside of combat.

Yes, of course!

[previewyoutube=zKJ5mAwTCP0;full][/previewyoutube]

And here’s an updated look at sailing.

[previewyoutube=Y51Bv0017KU;full][/previewyoutube]

The combat hud also got a revamp! While not quite final, this new version offers more breathing space and readability.
